stem: A rolling cart repeatedly blocks part of an exit aisle during harvest work. What is the strongest control?
choices: Redesign the cart parking and material-flow process so the exit route remains continuously clear
Mark the cart with brighter tape and leave it in the aisle
Allow blockage when the room is busy
Rely on workers to move the cart only during an emergency
rationale: Emergency egress should remain continuously available; the work process should be redesigned so routine operations do not create the hazard.
